command.mac:
Copy the pages this Claude account owns for my repos into git. This is a claude.ai cloud session signed in to one of my personal accounts. I have more than one personal account, so this account may hold only some of the pages. Copy what it holds, list the rest as "not in this account", and go on. A second run, in my other account, adds to the same branches. Ask me when a page's repo is unclear; do not guess.

Shell rules for this run: shell variables do not carry from one command to the next, so write every path in full. Below, `T` stands for the folder that step 3 makes, `R` for a repo name, `L` for this account's label. Run each git command on its own, never chained with `;` or `&&`, and keep its output.

Known claude-settings pages (id, link):
waiting-mockups-v13 https://claude.ai/artifact/2DodmME3zxVTmi26B3KzBR
c103-brief https://claude.ai/artifact/NGf6aaaVp2bF1i3kyhF5HD
c127-survey https://claude.ai/artifact/K4ixuAMi4ycpBvgm2x4k3H
old-queue https://claude.ai/artifact/9PJB2skRSMtCC4XHvzbmB8
c52-plan https://claude.ai/artifact/U4jM83VeaTVmePCDig78fD
roadmap-page https://claude.ai/artifact/JGqfvgXBuLqWUm1CX6Bv5h
ios-report https://claude.ai/artifact/36CtFQ6CaTszMaxxZvuCXq
mailaudit-page https://claude.ai/artifact/FBKSLCBLJsvfNGeePvDz13

1. Account label. Ask me for a short label for this account, such as `personal1` or `personal2`: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, never an email. That is L. Each account gets a different L.
2. List every artifact. `Artifact` action `list`, scope `mine`, `limit` 200, following `page_token` until none is left. If the list is empty, stop and tell me. Mark each known page above as held (its link is in the list) or "not in this account". Give each other listed artifact a repo (claude-settings, degen, banchi, or another of mine under github.com/shivinate7) from its title, and from its page text when the title is unclear. Show me the table: repo, title, link, proposed id (a slug of 32 characters or fewer). Ask me about each unclear row, and wait for my word before step 3. A page that belongs to no repo stays out.
3. Set up the code in fresh clones; never use the session's own checkout or ~/.claude. Run `mktemp -d` once; its printed path is T. For claude-settings and each other repo R in the table:
   a. Call `add_repo` with owner `shivinate7`, repo R, access `push`. Do not check the repo first with curl, gh or git ls-remote. If add_repo refuses, leave R out, say which repo and the reason it gave, and tell me the fix: connect GitHub for this Claude account at https://claude.ai/connect-github, and install the Claude GitHub App on the repo from that same page; then run this prompt again in a new session. Go on with the other repos. If claude-settings is refused, stop: every later step needs it.
   b. `git clone https://github.com/shivinate7/R T/R`
   c. `git -C T/R ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin artifact-pages-other-account`. If it finds the branch: `git -C T/R checkout artifact-pages-other-account`. If not: `git -C T/R checkout -b artifact-pages-other-account`.
   d. If `T/R/.claude/layout-extras.json` does not exist, leave R out and report it.
4. Register, in each repo's `T/R/.claude/layout-extras.json` under the `artifacts` key (make the key if missing). For each held page: if an entry already holds its link, keep that entry's id, set `"account": "L"` and `"collections": []`, and drop any `"export": false`. Otherwise add `{"id": "<id>", "url": "<link>", "role": "reference", "account": "L", "collections": []}`; an id already taken by another link gets a `-2` suffix. Never change an entry of a page this account does not hold. Then run `python3 T/claude-settings/lint/layout.py artifacts T/R` for each repo; it must list the entries with no error.
5. Fetch into `T/fetched-R`. For each held page: make `T/fetched-R/<id>/`. `Artifact` action `read` on its link. Copy the saved file the result names to `T/fetched-R/<id>/page.html` with `cp`, byte for byte; never retype it. If that file is empty, or the read failed, delete `T/fetched-R/<id>/`, set that registry entry back as it was, and report the page. Then `Artifact` action `list`, scope `files`, on the link; if it lists files other than `index.html`, `Artifact` action `read` with `paths` set to them and `out_dir` set to `T/fetched-R/<id>/files`.
6. Database check. For each held page, search `page.html` for `window.claude` database calls. If a page uses a database, name its collections from the code. For each: `ArtifactData list`, `out_dir` `T/fetched-R/<id>` (the tool writes the `<collection>` folder itself), `query.limit` 1000, follow `next_cursor` until empty, then `mkdir -p T/fetched-R/<id>/<collection>` (an empty collection writes no folder) and `touch T/fetched-R/<id>/<collection>/.complete`. A list that errors or ends with a cursor pending: touch nothing, and report it. Then set that entry's `"collections"` to those names.
7. Record branch worktree, per repo with a held page:
   a. `python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'T/claude-settings/lint'); import layout; print(layout.record_branch('T/R'))"` prints the record branch; call it B.
   b. `git -C T/R ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin artifact-pages-export`. If it finds the branch: `git -C T/R fetch origin artifact-pages-export`, then `git -C T/R worktree add T/R-rec -B artifact-pages-export origin/artifact-pages-export`.
   c. If not: `git -C T/R fetch origin B`, then `git -C T/R worktree add T/R-rec -b artifact-pages-export origin/B`. If origin has no branch B either, leave R's export out and report it.
8. Export, with the secret and personal-data scan, before anything is pushed. Per repo with a held page:
   `python3 T/claude-settings/skills/waiting-page/export_page.py --all T/R --account L --fetched T/fetched-R --worktree T/R-rec`
   Entries of other accounts print `skipped - account <label>`; each held page prints one line. A `refused` line names a file, a JSON path and a kind. Never edit page content to pass the scan; leave that page out and report its lines.
9. Push only scanned output, adding to the branches; never force. Run this even when step 8 exits 1 or 2: a refused or unknown page wrote nothing. Per repo:
   a. `git -C T/R-rec add artifacts`, then `git -C T/R-rec commit -m "Copy L reference pages into artifacts/"`, then `git -C T/R-rec push -u origin artifact-pages-export`.
   b. If its registry changed: `git -C T/R commit -am "Register L reference pages"`, then `git -C T/R push -u origin artifact-pages-other-account`.
   c. If a push is refused because the branch moved: `git -C <that folder> pull --rebase origin <that branch>`, then push again once.
10. Reply with L, then per repo: the export's printed lines, pages "not in this account", pages left out and why, collections added, and each pushed commit hash. Do not open a PR.

context:
Your 398 note asks that each repo's page hold both accounts' parts. This is the first half: the other account copies every page it owns for your repos (claude-settings, degen, banchi and any other) into git, on per-repo branches. It asks you when a page's repo is unclear, and it opens no PR. The second half, adding those copies to each live page, is step page-merge-two-accounts.
Why you: these pages belong to your other Claude account, which no session here can reach.

reply: 18:49 CST Nov 8: the outlook run arrived in triage's chat. 18:54 CST: the gmail run's commits are on claude-settings' branches: registry 8270b1301 and 15bf8ad7f, export 48209bd00 and 8492f61ee (git read 18:54 CST). Both accounts are copied, so this task is closed. roadmap-page is in neither account and stays held with no copy (63e3db1f5). short: Other account: copy its pages to git
steps: Open a new Claude Code cloud session at https://claude.ai/code, signed in to one personal account. Any repo, or none, is fine.
Paste the command below as its first message. Give it a label such as personal1, and answer its questions about unclear rows.

Repeat in a new cloud session signed in to your other personal account, with a different label such as personal2. Each run copies only the pages its account holds and lists the rest as "not in this account".
If a run says a repo was refused, it names the fix: connect GitHub for that account and install the Claude GitHub App on the repo.
Paste each run's reply into this item's note and press Done after the second run.
title: Copy the other account's pages for all your repos into git
